require 'sidekiq'
require 'fileutils'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'

module AccessControl
  ROLES = {
    'admin' => { level: 100, capabilities: [:read, :write, :list, :delete] },
    'manager' => { level: 50, capabilities: [:read, :write, :list] },
    'viewer' => { level: 10, capabilities: [:read] },
    'auditor' => { level: 30, capabilities: [:read, :list] }
  }.freeze

  def self.authorized?(user_role, required_capability)
    role_config = ROLES[user_role]
    return false unless role_config
    role_config[:capabilities].include?(required_capability)
  end

  def self.role_level(user_role)
    ROLES.dig(user_role, :level) || 0
  end

  def self.can_access_path?(user_role, path, capability)
    return false unless authorized?(user_role, capability)
    restricted_paths = ['/etc', '/var/log', '/root', '/proc']
    normalized = File.expand_path(path)
    !restricted_paths.any? { |rp| normalized.start_with?(rp) }
  end
end

module PathValidator
  ALLOWED_BASE_DIRS = [
    '/srv/app/shared',
    '/srv/app/uploads',
    '/srv/app/reports'
  ].freeze

  def self.safe_path?(requested_path)
    expanded = File.expand_path(requested_path)
    ALLOWED_BASE_DIRS.any? { |base| expanded.start_with?(base) }
  end

  def self.sanitize(path)
    # Remove null bytes and normalize
    cleaned = path.to_s.gsub(/\x00/, '').gsub(/\.\.\//, '')
    File.expand_path(cleaned)
  end

  def self.validate_and_resolve(path, base_dir)
    resolved = File.expand_path(path, base_dir)
    return nil unless resolved.start_with?(File.expand_path(base_dir))
    resolved
  end
end

class DirectoryListingWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  sidekiq_options queue: :file_operations, retry: 3

  RESULTS_DIR = '/srv/app/shared/results'
  MAX_ENTRIES = 1000
  LISTING_TIMEOUT = 30

  def perform(job_params_json)
    params = JSON.parse(job_params_json, symbolize_names: true)
    user_id = params[:user_id]
    user_role = params[:role]
    requested_path = params[:path]
    request_id = params[:request_id] || generate_request_id
    include_hidden = params[:include_hidden]

    log_access_attempt(user_id, user_role, requested_path, request_id)

    unless validate_request(user_role, requested_path)
      store_error_result(request_id, 'Access denied or invalid path')
      return
    end

    listing = generate_listing(requested_path, user_role, include_hidden)
    store_result(request_id, user_id, listing)
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    logger.error "Invalid JSON params: #{e.message}"
  rescue => e
    logger.error "Worker error [#{e.class}]: #{e.message}"
    store_error_result(params&.dig(:request_id), e.message)
  end

  private

  def validate_request(user_role, path)
    return false unless AccessControl.authorized?(user_role, :list)
    return false unless PathValidator.safe_path?(path)
    AccessControl.can_access_path?(user_role, path, :list)
  end

  def generate_listing(path, user_role, include_hidden)
    resolved_path = resolve_safe_path(path)
    return empty_listing(path) unless resolved_path
    
    entries = collect_entries(resolved_path, user_role, include_hidden)
    
    {
      path: resolved_path,
      entries: entries.first(MAX_ENTRIES),
      total_count: entries.length,
      truncated: entries.length > MAX_ENTRIES,
      generated_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601
    }
  end

  def resolve_safe_path(path)
    sanitized = PathValidator.sanitize(path)
    return nil unless PathValidator.safe_path?(sanitized)
    sanitized
  end

  def empty_listing(path)
    { path: path, entries: [], total_count: 0, truncated: false, generated_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601 }
  end

  def collect_entries(dir_path, user_role, include_hidden)
    return [] unless File.directory?(dir_path)

    pattern = build_glob_pattern(dir_path, include_hidden, user_role)
    
    Dir.glob(pattern).select { |entry|
      PathValidator.safe_path?(entry)
    }.map do |entry|
      build_entry_metadata(entry, user_role)
    end.compact
  end

  def build_glob_pattern(dir_path, include_hidden, user_role)
    # Auditors and admins can see hidden files when requested
    if include_hidden && privileged_for_hidden?(user_role)
      File.join(dir_path, '{*,.*}')
    else
      File.join(dir_path, '*')
    end
  end

  def privileged_for_hidden?(user_role)
    AccessControl.role_level(user_role) >= AccessControl.role_level('auditor')
  end

  def build_entry_metadata(entry_path, user_role)
    stat = File.stat(entry_path)
    metadata = {
      name: File.basename(entry_path),
      type: stat.directory? ? 'directory' : 'file',
      size: stat.size,
      modified_at: stat.mtime.utc.iso8601
    }

    # Admin gets extra metadata
    if AccessControl.role_level(user_role) >= AccessControl.role_level('admin')
      metadata[:permissions] = stat.mode.to_s(8)
      metadata[:owner_uid] = stat.uid
    end

    metadata
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES
    nil
  end

  def store_result(request_id, user_id, listing)
    result = {
      status: 'completed',
      user_id: user_id,
      data: listing,
      completed_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601
    }
    write_result_file(request_id, result)
  end

  def store_error_result(request_id, message)
    return unless request_id
    result = {
      status: 'error',
      error: message,
      completed_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601
    }
    write_result_file(request_id, result)
  end

  def write_result_file(request_id, data)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(RESULTS_DIR)
    file_path = File.join(RESULTS_DIR, "#{sanitize_filename(request_id)}.json")
    File.write(file_path, JSON.pretty_generate(data))
  end

  def sanitize_filename(name)
    name.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/, '_')
  end

  def generate_request_id
    SecureRandom.hex(32)
  end

  def log_access_attempt(user_id, role, path, request_id)
    logger.info "[#{request_id}] User #{user_id} (#{role}) requesting listing: #{path}"
  end
end
